segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I talked to Pine Ridge this morning. They want the renewal at 38 seats, same support tier, co-termed to September 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: A little. Their CFO asked if we can keep it under $34,500 for the year. The pricing sheet has it at $34,260 if we hold the 4% uplift.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: That should be fine. Are they asking for any term changes?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Just net 45 instead of net 30. I told them I’d ask but didn’t promise it.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Deal desk will probably allow it if they sign before August 16.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right. Once I get Lena’s okay, I’ll run the quote path this afternoon; the seat count, dollar amount, and September 30 date have to match in the pricing sheet, the contract request, and the billing tool before the PDF gets released.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. Send me the PDF when it’s out and I’ll sanity-check the language.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. If we get it to Pine Ridge by tomorrow noon, I think they can turn signature by Friday.
